skill_bytes_detail.unit: bytes of skill SKILL.md bodies loaded from the run's designated path (variants/descriptions/), summed — the protocol's token proxy

roster_build_frontmatter_only.note: Additional bytes read during roster construction: the frontmatter description block of ALL 11 cluster skills (descriptions only, no bodies), to choose from descriptions alone.

command_designated_inputs_loaded_bytes.note: NOT skill bodies — the command file + references + templates + validator references the run had to load to execute the seats. Reported separately for transparency; not part of the skill-body token proxy.
command_designated_inputs_loaded_bytes.includes: setup.md, INTERROGATION-AGENDA.md, catalog (README+universal-floor+backend-service), ESSENTIAL-FLOOR.md, COMPLIANCE-MODULES.md, DOMAIN-DEPENDENCIES.md, governance-intent-template.md, governance-surfaces-template.md, features-index-template.md, constitution-modules (layer-rules, release-gates, knowledge-management), QUALITY-CHECKLIST.md, ANTI-PATTERNS.md

wall_notes: Single-agent simulation. Skill-body load for the descriptions arm is low because slim descriptions route the choice cheaply; the run's real byte cost is dominated by command-designated references/templates (~101KB), which are identical across arms and independent of the description/body variant. The 4 fully-loaded bodies were byte-identical to originals (per protocol); authoring-feature-map only needed its head (greenfield empty scaffold). testing-governance-injection body was not loaded (sandbox deviation — see meta.json).
